title: Mark McCandlish's alien reproduction vehicles

tellings.quote: then the Mark McCandish like alien reproduction vehicles like we have workable craft that uses,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions the claims of a man named Mark McCandlish about alien reproduction vehicles, meaning craft that humans built by copying technology from other beings. As Michels puts it, the claim is that the United States has working craft of this kind. If true, it would mean such technology has already been copied and put to use.
